description: This file is a Spring MVC controller class managing customer options in an e-commerce admin panel. It handles listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting customer options with localization support and AJAX endpoints.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing customer options, including listing, editing, creating, deleting, and processing AJAX requests for customer options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of customer options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the form for editing an existing customer option.

methods.name: displayOptionCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the form for creating a new customer option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Shared private method to prepare the customer option form for either editing or creating.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a customer option, including validation.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to fetch paginated list of customer options in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set menu context for the administrative UI.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a customer option with authorization checks.
